01 / 13The model 

We take over the running. You keep the hotel.

BOA Hotels operates upscale hotels in Portugal. With the by BOA model we take over an existing hotel from the owner who runs it today, with an agreed upgrade. We run it with our team, our systems and our commercial engine, and we add it to the BOA Hotels collection. Under your name, or ours.

You keep

  • The hotel, and everything in it.
  • The decisions that matter: the yearly budget, the upgrade, the brand.
  • Your name on the door, if you want it.
  • Your team. In the management partnership they stay employed by your company.

We take over

  • The running, all of it: the hotel manager and every position, recruited, trained and managed by BOA.
  • Pricing and distribution, sales, marketing and PR, purchasing, quality, reporting.
  • The upgrade, from concept to site.
  • The technology, with AI across the operation and the sales.

We share

  • The result, the way you choose.
  • Carry the costs yourself and pay us fees that move with your profit.
  • Or hand us the costs and receive a share of revenue every month.
  • Either way, our income follows yours.

04 / 13Two ways to partner 

In both, BOA runs the hotel. You choose who carries the costs.

Switch to see what changes.

The management partnership

Your company stays the operator of record. It employs the team, carries the operating costs and keeps the revenue. BOA runs the hotel through the team and is compensated with fees. The natural route for an owner-operator who already has the company, the licences and the people.

The operating partnership

BOA's operating company becomes the operator. The team transfers to BOA, BOA carries every operating cost, and you receive a share of net revenue every month. For the owner who wants income without operations, and a clean handover.

05 / 13Our compensation 

We earn from the result we create.

Our compensation is built into the structure you choose, and it follows the hotel's result rather than a fixed charge. The figures for your hotel are set in the business plan you see before you sign. The logic is the same in both cases: the better the hotel does, the better we do.

When you carry the costs

The management partnership

  1. Revenue
  2. lessOperating costs
  3. equalsGross operating profit
  4. lessBOA's fees
  5. equalsYour result

Your company keeps the revenue and carries the costs, as today. BOA's fees have three parts. A base fee on revenue, for the team and the services that run the hotel, with nothing recharged on top. An incentive on gross operating profit, so we earn more only when your profit grows. And a fee on direct sales, for the bookings we bring in without commission.

When BOA carries the costs

The operating partnership

  1. Revenue
  2. lessDistribution costs
  3. equalsNet revenue
  4. a fixed share, every monthYour share
  5. the restStays with BOA, which pays every operating cost

BOA carries every operating cost and keeps the revenue. You receive a fixed share of net revenue every month, net meaning after OTA commissions, advertising, third-party services and transaction costs. It is computed from the top line, which you can verify, never from our costs. There is no rent and no guarantee: your income follows the hotel, season by season. A lower share in the first period reflects the pre-opening and the working capital BOA carries.

Gross operating profit follows the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry, before management fees. Net revenue is defined as above. Both are fixed once, in the contract.

08 / 13The upgrade 

The upgrade is where the partnership begins.

BOA plans and leads the interiors, furniture, fixtures and equipment so the hotel matches the brand it carries, for a fee set as a percentage of the works budget. You contract and pay the suppliers directly, and you own everything that is installed. The budget is in the business plan before you sign. Where the works are heavier, BOA manages the development as well.

  1. Concept and budgetThe direction, the scope and the money, approved by you before any drawing is detailed.
  2. Design and specificationRooms, public areas, the FF&E list, approved by you before anything is bought.
  3. Procurement and siteSuppliers tendered and supervised by BOA, contracted and paid by you.
Village by BOA · interiors by BOA

09 / 13The commitment 

Ten years, two renewals, and two moments to walk away.

We fix the goals with you at signature, in the business plan. At the end of year two and year five we measure the hotel against them, on the figures we report to you. If we are below the goals, you may end the contract.

Year 2Performance reviewYear 5Performance reviewYear 10First renewalYear 15Second renewal
Years one to tenRenewal, five yearsRenewal, five years

What you approve

The upgrade budget and the design at each gate. In the management partnership, the yearly budget. A report every month, a meeting every year.

What stays yours

The building, the furniture and the equipment, and your brand where we created it for you. BOA brings the operation, the brand and the design, not capital: no key money, no guarantee.

If you sell

The contract follows the property. The buyer receives a running hotel with its team, its systems and its brand, which is part of what they pay for.

Exclusivity

The hotel is run by BOA alone for the term, under the standards that make it part of the collection.

10 / 13How it starts 

From a first meeting to the take-over.

  1. We meet and analyse

    Your hotel's performance and each of its areas: rooms, food and beverage, the spaces that earn and the ones that could. Under NDA.

  2. We build the business plan

    Performance projections, the upgrade the hotel needs with a cost analysis, and the goals the plan is built to reach.

  3. BOA takes over

    On signature: the team, the systems, the upgrade and the brand, in three to six months depending on the hotel.

  4. You receive the reports

    A report every month. Once a year we review the performance together and you approve the annual budget.

The hotel

From 10 keys, ideally 30 to 50. Operating today, with an owner who runs it. Room to grow is a plus.

The place

Anywhere in Portugal, the islands included.

The positioning

Premium, or the potential to get there with the upgrade, the right brand and our operation.
